Hi Mikko,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across The Heroborn and Flashes in Time while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Sasha, the young mage in a land of magic made science who is always fearful of being found out, and in the stories of Flashes in Time, from an AI assistant whispering in your ear to hacking the structure of reality for a prom date.

Those details gave me an idea for how email marketing could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. Your site points readers to Twitter, Facebook and Amazon, but I didn't see a newsletter signup. A simple reader list, opened with your free story "The End of Suffering", could keep those readers close until the longer work you mentioned is ready.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

Pozdrav Franka,

Moje ime je Roland Jacobs. Dizajner sam i stručnjak za usluge vezane uz knjige te pomažem autorima da profesionalno predstave, objave i promoviraju svoje knjige.

Na Vaše knjige Kora i začarani izvor i Anara: Sjena Jantarnog mora naišao sam istražujući Vaš rad. Posebno su me zainteresirala bića iz mitova i legendi, vile, vilenjaci i čuvari šuma, koja žive na čarolijom prožetim lokacijama Gorskog kotara, kao i Elin, koja nakon raskola dvaju svjetova prelazi iz Meresa u Anaru i neočekivano postaje članica vijeća.

Ti su me detalji naveli na ideju kako bi kratki knjižni trailer mogao predstaviti Vaše knjige većem broju čitatelja koji bi u njima uživali. Za Koru bi se trailer mogao osloniti na stvarne krajolike Gorskog kotara i ilustracije Klare Stilinović Tušek, a za Anaru na kontrast dvaju svjetova koji su se nakon potresa razvili potpuno različito.

Rado bih pripremio besplatan konceptni uzorak kako biste vidjeli smjer koji imam na umu.

Biste li bili voljni pogledati ga?

Srdačan pozdrav,
Roland Jacobs

leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi J.S.,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Noidanlanka and Tytär hämärän, piika pimeän while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Noa, the pearl whisperer's daughter who sets out to find the Witch of Sardesia to cure her sister's deadly sleep sickness, and in Rauniara, a duchy that has lost three of its seasons and is left with autumn, night and fear.

Those details gave me an idea for how a focused book promotion campaign could present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. With this autumn's release of Metsänkorva, the standalone prequel about Meusalina, a campaign could lead readers of the Tähtifantasia-nominated Noidanlanka straight to the new book, built around the pearls and threads both stories share.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
